title: Your Venus sign exposes you.
caption: Fire Venus rented a blimp and a backup blimp. Earth Venus bakes you bread every day. Air Venus wants to hear everything again, slower. Water Venus is flooding, it's fine. And Venus never gets far from the Sun. Which Venus are you?
